text: SRAM, the Chicago-based bicycle-component manufacturer, is a private company owned by the Day family and its management team (co-founder Stan Day, who stepped down as CEO in January 2019 and stayed on as chairman).
short: SRAM is owned by the Day family and its management team.

source.name: Pinkbike (via Wayback Machine): 'SRAM CEO Stan Day Steps Down After 31 Years'
source.quote: SRAM will continue to be a private company owned by the Day Family and the management team. It will continue to focus its innovation and business within the bike industry.
source.note: Quote is from co-founder Stan Day's own statement in the article; the live pinkbike.com URL (403 for scripts) is archived here. Article text adds: 'Reportedly, SRAM is a privately owned corporation, with most of its shares owned by the Day family and the company founders'.
